digest.component_or_area: op-cert signing and MCP health subsystem
propositions: sign_manifest and mint_opcert_record mint op-cert signatures without verifying that the resolved signing key's public counterpart is resolvable by the same-environment verify path, causing silently uncertifiable attestations
no guard surfaces this divergence at mint time, so signing succeeds while verify later returns foreign_key or a refused claim, potentially long after certificates were minted

the MCP server startup path does not check whether the bound signer's public key matches the pinned trusted-environment key for its principal, leaving environment-binding misconfigurations undetected at deploy time

_warn_if_verify_cannot_resolve logs a WARNING naming the resolved key path and principal when the specific signed key's public counterpart is not in _opcert_own_public_keys, even if another chain key's pub resolves, while still returning the signature

run_startup_opcert_check reports a DEGRADED opcert health field and logs a boot warning when the bound signer's public key does not match the pinned trusted-environment key, serving non-degraded when it matches or when unbound/not pinned
both guards are in-process and operation-linked with no CI provider dependency; mint guard never refuses and does not break existing success paths
